title: Model onboarding — KV cache footprint & regional GPU capacity impact
content:
Purpose:
This working sheet captures a rapid capacity-impact analysis for onboarding model: rwd-7B-v2-opt (hypothetical). Focus areas: regional GPU headroom, KV-cache footprint per model shard, expected change to per-region p95 latency under staged rollout, and recommended rollout throttles and monitoring hooks.

Summary (TL;DR):
- rwd-7B-v2-opt increases average per-request KV payload by ~1.8x vs current baseline (rwd-3B).
- On a 20% global rollout (traffic-weighted), our simulated extra GPU memory pressure requires ~12% more LRU-backed KV RAM on A100 pools in us-west1.
- If rollout >50% without quantization or reduced prefix-kv, us-west1 A100 cluster will cross the soft-utilization threshold (85% GPU mem reserved for model + cache), causing degradation risk for warm-start requests.
- Recommend: staggered canary (1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50%) with automated KV TTL tuning and an autoscale step for A100 pools in affected regions at 20% rollout.

Assumptions (inputs to the simulation):
- Baseline traffic profile: total QPS 25k (global), region split: us-west1 45%, us-east1 30%, eu-west1 20%, ap-southeast1 5%.
- Current fleet (representative):
  - us-west1: 40x A100-40GB (serving-runtime pool), 16x L4 (inference-cache-offload)
  - us-east1: 28x A100-40GB, 8x L4
  - eu-west1: 18x A100-40GB, 6x L4
  - ap-southeast1: 6x L4 (no A100 in this region yet)
- Baseline model (rwd-3B): avg KV per active session ~260MB (prefix + KV shards), hit-rate 72%, median per-token latency 18ms on A100; usable model memory per GPU: 34GB (after runtime overhead/reserve).
- New model (rwd-7B-v2-opt): model memory footprint (quantized) ~22GB, avg KV per active session ~470MB (observed in test harness), estimated cache hit-rate 78% due to increased locality with longer prefixes.
- KV strategy: per-request prefix caching + per-session KV shard kept in GPU DRAM for N active sessions per worker; eviction is LRU with TTL=30m by default.
- Batching/throughput: we maintain current batching policy (dynamic batching, target latency SLO 100ms for tail).

Simulation approach (high-level):
- Synthetic workload generator replaying sampled production traces scaled to baseline QPS.
- Request-to-shard mapping recreated; avg active sessions per user-agent distribution preserved.
- Memory accounting per GPU: model_base + resident_kv + runtime_overhead (kernel buffers, CUDA allocations).
- Eviction/TTL behavior simulated over 6-hour ramp windows.

Key results (by region) for a 20% global rollout (traffic-weighted):
- us-west1 (45% baseline traffic):
  - Effective active sessions on A100 pool for rwd-7B-v2-opt: +14k sessions concurrently across pool (after weighted routing).
  - Additional resident KV needed: ~6.3TB total across pool -> ~158GB per A100 node on average (spread across GPUs given per-shard placement).
  - Avg per-GPU free RAM remaining after model + KV + overhead: 5.6GB -> soft-utilization 83.5%.
  - Observed p95 token latency delta: +12ms (from baseline 18ms -> 30ms) due to reduced headroom for transient allocations.
- us-east1:
  - Added KV: ~3.9TB total -> ~139GB per A100 node avg.
  - Free RAM remaining: 7.8GB -> soft-utilization 76%.
  - p95 delta: +8ms.
- eu-west1:
  - Added KV: ~2.1TB total -> ~116GB per node avg.
  - Free RAM remaining: 9.2GB -> soft-utilization 72%.
- ap-southeast1:
  - No A100 capacity; traffic served by L4 instances with offloaded KV strategy (larger network fetch hit).
  - Increased outbound bandwidth by ~18% (monitor network egress and latency).

Sensitivity checks:
- If KV TTL shortened from 30m -> 10m, per-GPU KV resident drops ~38% (us-west1: from 158GB -> ~98GB) and p95 delta reduces to +6ms.
- If prefix trimming (reduce saved prefix length by 40%) enabled, resident KV drops ~30% with minimal quality loss in manual QA; p95 delta reduces to +5ms.
- If rollout jumps to 50% without autoscale, us-west1 GPU mem headroom crosses 90% and simulated cold-start fail/retry loops increase request tail latency >100ms.

Operational recommendations (short):
1) Canary/Rollout sequence: 1% (24h) -> 5% (24h) -> 20% (48h) -> 50% (48h) -> full. Each step gated by: p95 latency delta < +15ms AND KV eviction OOMs == 0 AND GPU utilization < 85%.
2) Autoscale policy tweak: pre-apply step scale at 20% rollout for us-west1 A100 pool: +10 GPUs (or enable burst capacity).
3) KV tuning: enable temporary TTL reduction (30m -> 10m) during ramp phases and run prefix-trimming A/B to validate quality tradeoffs.
4) Fallback routing: place automatic fallback to rwd-3B for requests when target node free memory < 5GB or per-request KV miss rate spikes >20% to avoid retries.
5) Monitoring hooks: add these dashboards/alerts before rollouts:
   - per-region per-GPU free RAM gauge (10m aggregation)
   - KV resident bytes per GPU (15s) and eviction rate (1m)
   - tail latency (p95/p99) of token generation, with rollout tag
   - autoscale decision latency and burst activation count

Action items (owners):
- infra: Diego Ramos -> implement autoscale policy change + canary routing flags (ETA 3 days).
- serving-runtime: Eve Chen -> add per-GPU KV resident metric + eviction counters to telemetry (ETA 5 days).
- perf/research: Rafael Nunes -> run end-to-end simulation with synthetic traffic including 50% quantized variant (ETA 4 days).
- product: Aisha Patel -> coordinate rollout gating and update runbook (ETA 2 days).

Open questions / risks:
- Quality tradeoff of prefix trimming: need systematic eval with our existing eval suite (edge cases for long context generative tasks).
- L4-serving fallback latency impact for APAC: estimate network latencies under peak; may need a small A100 presence in ap-southeast1 if APAC usage grows.
- Persistent memory fragmentation on long-lived workers: simulation assumes defragmentation between restarts; need to validate on canary cluster.

Appendix (simulation table snapshots):
- Table: per-region capacity delta (20% rollout)
  region, baseline-A100, added-KV-total, avg-KV-per-node, free-ram-after (GB), soft-util(%)
  us-west1, 40, 6.3TB, 158GB, 5.6, 83.5
  us-east1, 28, 3.9TB, 139GB, 7.8, 76.0
  eu-west1, 18, 2.1TB, 116GB, 9.2, 72.0
  ap-southeast1, 0 A100, 0 (L4 offload), N/A, N/A

- Table: latency impact summary (p50/p95 token latency)
  model, region, p50_base, p95_base, p50_new, p95_new
  rwd-3B, us-west1, 9ms, 18ms, 9ms, 18ms
  rwd-7B-v2-opt, us-west1, 10ms, 30ms (delta +12ms)

Notes and provenance:
- KV per-session numbers measured from local test harness (sim-run-2025-10-15) using representative prefix workloads (sampling from production prompt corpus).
- Model memory estimates from model-ops (quantization config: 4-bit Q4f16-style sim).
- Autoscale cost estimate: +10 A100 for us-west1 ~ incremental $36k/month (back-of-envelope) — finance sign-off needed for reserved capacity.

Next steps for this doc:
- Perf team to run one controlled canary in us-west1 with TTL=10m and prefix-trim A/B to collect real telemetry (Rafael to coordinate).
- Update Confluence playbook with final gating thresholds and add checklist for rollback triggers.

-- end of working sheet --
